name: Web Tools Weekly

sources.title: Suggest a Tool — submission via X/Bluesky DM

requirements: Front-end developer tool fit: libraries, frameworks, plugins, scripts, web/desktop/mobile apps, APIs/services, editors/IDEs
Explicitly NOT accepted: articles and tutorials
Productivity tools go to the curator's other newsletter, Tech Productivity (techproductivity.co)
Submission channel is a DM/chat to the curator, Louis Lazaris — @LouisLazaris on X (DMs open) or @LouisLazaris.com on Bluesky (chats open)
preparation: An X or Bluesky account to send the DM/chat
Tool name, URL, one-line description of what it does for front-end devs
Confirm it isn't already covered — browse webtoolsweekly.com/archive
workflow: Open https://webtoolsweekly.com/submit to confirm current instructions
DM @LouisLazaris on X or open a Bluesky chat with @LouisLazaris.com
Send the tool name, link and short pitch
If picked, the tool is included in a future Web Tools Weekly newsletter issue and the online archive
watchFor: No form and no guaranteed inclusion — it's a curated newsletter, not a directory; acceptance is one person's call
Newsletter-cadence timing means publication can lag submission by weeks
Separate 'sponsor' route exists at /sponsor if you want guaranteed placement (paid)
countsAsLive: The tool appears in a Web Tools Weekly issue and in the site's archive at webtoolsweekly.com/archive
unknowns: Whether archive entries carry outbound links (likely yes, newsletter style — unverified)
